beats.headline: A key for the winner
beats.text: Zev's harried voice announces the containment bubbles and the rule change that comes with them: a destroyed vehicle or a killed mount no longer loses the race outright, though last place still does. And from now on, the team that wins is given a key. That key opens a single garage of a defeated team, where there may be supplies to upgrade a vehicle or mount, other items, and in some cases an entire vehicle or mount, which can be added to the team's garage and swapped in at pit stops.

beats.headline: Two Golden upgrades and a key
beats.text: Carl's team has won the heat. Hedy, reading the room and unusually subdued, has two Golden upgrades to offer and a key, which means they can go into any of the old houses in the cul-de-sac; if they mean to trade vehicles, she says, do that before picking. Carl already knows: the house of One Fine Pig, whose armoured vehicle he rates below his own truck. Imani reports that Louis has just used his key to add a gecko to his garage, and found an engineer in a hidden room.

beats.headline: The garage of One Fine Pig
beats.text: The abandoned houses stand in the order their teams lost, so One Fine Pig's is the closest. Osvaldo asks whether Carl is using his key; Osvaldo lost the chance at his own heat's garages when he moved. Carl puts his hand on the garage door and it yawns open. Next to the parked APV with the cracked windshield stands Penelope the pig, licking up the remains of a gremlin. Hi, Penny, says Carl, going to a knee. She snorts happily and follows them out.

beats.headline: Dwight's last two
beats.text: Donut bounds away before Carl can stop her, rushes to a garage door, swipes and goes in. The keys, he realises: Dwight had two left, and she has looted them from him. She goes into the garage of the razor foxes and then into the garage of the Jugglers, and it takes maybe two minutes. She comes back grumbling, having moved Onikuma the bear and Old Shuck the dog to their own garage, and she is not going to talk about it. They will need them for the parade.

relations.note: the garage it opened held her
Donut says he has two, and does not think he used them
